review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: A detour outside the ancestor path is dominated by transferring at its LCA because ancestral per-distance prices are no larger and fixed fees are nonnegative. Thus dp(u)=dist(u)P(u)+Q(u)+min_ancestor(dp(v)-dist(v)P(u)). Maintain the lower hull of ancestor lines with decreasing distance slopes. Binary-search both queries and the insertion truncation point, and roll back one overwritten hull slot after each DFS subtree. Equal-distance dominated lines are skipped; no sibling hull leaks across branches.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
